definitions.gloss: to praise to the skies; to heap praise on
definitions.explanation: To praise someone or something excessively or effusively. The auxiliary ちぎる adds a sense of doing something with great intensity or abandon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{褒|ほ}めちぎられた。
examples.english: I was praised lavishly by the teacher.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{皆|みんな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{褒|ほ}めちぎった。
examples.english: Everyone heaped praise on her cooking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦{評論家|ひょうろんか}→評論家：16405_hyouronka⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧こぞって⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{褒|ほ}めちぎって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Film critics are all praising the new movie to the skies.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Godan verb (る→ら/り/る/れ/ろ). The ちぎる auxiliary attaches to the masu-stem of verbs and means to do something intensely or without restraint.
- A⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧B⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{褒|ほ}めちぎる (B praises A effusively)
- {褒|ほ}めちぎられる (to be praised lavishly — passive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{絶賛|ぜっさん}→絶賛：13840_zessan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to give rave reviews — similar intensity but more formal)
- {褒|ほ}めちぎって⟦{持|も}ち{上|あ}げる→持ち上げる：02313_mochiageru⟧ (to praise and flatter)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{褒|ほ}める→褒める：01204_homeru⟧ means simply "to praise." {褒|ほ}めちぎる adds the nuance of excessive or effusive praise. ⟦{絶賛|ぜっさん}→絶賛：13840_zessan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is a more formal equivalent often used in media and reviews.
